exchanges.prompt:
INFORMATION
You are given one video frame from an industrial workcell.
Extract every relation you can see as <subject, predicate, object> triplets.

TRIPLETS EXTRACTION CRITERIA -- object categories
- worker
- wrench
- terminals
- beam
- panel
- screwdriver
- tape
- workbench

TRIPLETS EXTRACTION CRITERIA -- predicate dictionary
- holding
- knocking on
- on
- near
- installing
- above

TRIPLETS EXTRACTION CRITERIA -- examples
[positive] <worker, knocking on, panel> -- The hand contacts the panel repeatedly; `knocking on` is in the dictionary.
[negative] <worker, taping, panel> -- `taping` is not in the dictionary, so this triplet cannot be scored at all.

OUTPUT
One triplet per line, in <subject, predicate, object> form.
exchanges.completion:
<worker, holding, wrench>
<worker, near, workbench>
<worker, installing, terminals>

ANALYSIS_EN
Full criteria. Every entity is drawn from O and every predicate from P, and the draft is still wrong: `wrench` is not in the frame. Constraining the vocabulary constrains the form of the answer, not its truth, which is what step 2 exists for.
ANALYSIS_ZH
-
